say:2:1130634002:1.text: You buy an empty coffin and put something of your own in it—a weapon or pendant. Trick the reaper and anyone else into thinking you're long dead.
say:2:1130634002:1.source_cn: 买一口空棺材，在棺材里放上属于自己的东西，枪，或者挂坠...

say:3:1130634003:1.text: While it may not seem foolproof, this business is thriving. Sooner or later, those coffins will be put to real use.
